code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 2 for row in grid))
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols = [c for row in grid for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (2, background)]
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    marker = right + 1 if divider < left else left - 1
    for row in out:
        row[marker] = 8
    return out
'''
